lead: `nvs_stdlib_reaches_the_os_only_through_the_gate` is textual, so naming a forbidden type is as fatal as calling it.
body: The list is spellings (`std::fs`, `std::process::Command`, `std::env::var`) matched against the source above the file's `#[cfg(test)]` marker, so `fn write_chunk(file: &mut std::fs::File, ...)` and a `use std::fs::File;` both fail a gate about effects on a signature that performs none. Make the helper generic over `W: Write`, or infer the type from the door that answered it.
